## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Esoteric ritual manual by **Amoghavajra** ([不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA)) for the One-Syllable Crown-Wheel-King practice. Recension A of two parallel recensions (T954A = [KR6j0130](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0130) and T954B = [KR6j0131](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0131)).

**Abstract**

The text gives the daily-practice recitation manual for the One-Syllable Crown-Wheel-King — covering the *mudrā*-mantra-visualisation triplets, offering sequences, and *japa* of the principal one-syllable mantra. Companion to the underlying scriptures [KR6j0124](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0124) (T950) and [KR6j0128](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0128) (T953). The composition dates from Amoghavajra's mature Cháng'ān period (746–774).
